standard: Fuel delivery tickets and tank dip readings collected from receiving facilities

fields.name: record_type
fields.notes: DELIVERY (a ticket) or TANK_DIP (a level reading)

fields.name: delivered_utc
fields.notes: delivery time, or reading time for a dip

fields.name: supplier_id / supplier_name
fields.notes: entity_registry.json vendors[].vendor_id, or organizations.json org_id for government emergency fuel; empty for a fuel terminal's own wholesale purchases

fields.name: facility_id
fields.notes: facility_registry.json facility_id, infrastructure_assets.json asset_id (utility sites) or terminal_registry.json terminal_id

fields.name: receiving_asset_id
fields.notes: tank or generator in infrastructure_assets.json where one is registered

fields.name: carrier_type / carrier_id
fields.notes: truck or barge; carrier_id is a vessels.json vessel_id for barge deliveries

fields.name: contract_id
fields.notes: entity_registry.json contracts[].contract_id where the delivery is under a registered contract

fields.name: tank_level_before_pct / tank_level_after_pct
fields.notes: for dips both hold the reading

joins: EQP-1140 dips equal historian tag GW.UTL1.GEN.FUEL.PV; lot_id appears in work_orders.csv work_log where a crew cites it; carrier_id joins AIS through vessels.json
